frequency_question: What proportion of expiring bilateral water treaties are successfully renewed or replaced with a successor agreement within the final 105 days (or comparable short window) before expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal treaties governing transboundary river water allocation with defined expiration dates or mandatory review periods leading to renegotiation. Excludes purely domestic water laws or non-binding declarations.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named; represents standard historical compliance and renewal tendency for major water treaties.
known_gaps: Limited to prominent documented interstate water treaty frameworks.
skeleton: 4 named historical treaty renegotiation cycles or adjustment periods
validity_reason: Interstate water treaty norms evolve slowly over decades.
